evolution:
Use case: stylized-concept. A proposal-only character evolution sheet for the EXACT rune fox in references 1 and 2; reference 3 is the approved polished reward art style. THREE equally sized square cells arranged horizontally, on genuine transparent background. No text anywhere.
Keep ONE recognizable fox with the same orange fur, white muzzle and chest, upright dark-lined ears, expressive slanted eyes, huge upward curling white-tipped tail, turquoise rune markings, four paws, and a lifted front paw. Face LEFT in the same three-quarter pose as the reference. Lock the anatomy, proportions, pose, scale, head angle, baseline and centered placement across all three cells. The full body, all ears, entire tail and every toe visible with generous padding. Do not add armor, wings, horns, weapons, extra tails or extra limbs. This is a static design comparison, not an animation strip.
LEFT: the existing base rune fox, preserve the canonical subdued turquoise runes and natural orange/white fur.
MIDDLE: the same fox at the first higher visual rank. Preserve orange body. Simplify and brighten a few key turquoise runes into bold readable broad shapes: one clear chevron on forehead, strong curved mark over the shoulder, two broad luminous bands around the large tail. White chest slightly brighter; a very restrained cyan edge glow near the tail. No tiny decorative noise.
RIGHT: the same fox at the highest rank. Preserve the exact silhouette and orange head/body. Broaden the white/silver chest and front lower-leg socks and give the upper tail a larger pearly white area. The large cyan tail rune is now a radiant broad spiral with warm gold edge accents. Forehead rune is a single bright cyan diamond. Three bold cyan marks, not dozens of hairline filigrees, integrate into the existing flank markings. A small amount of crisp cyan-gold glint only at the tail and shoulder, no large aura cloud.
The three levels must be distinct when the full fox is only 95 pixels wide. Higher rank is shown by broad fur/rune patterns, not by a different-sized body or an unrelated costume. No ability symbols or UI medals attached to the body: shield, healing and attack will be separate shared effects and UI icons. No labels, numbers, paragraphs, dividers, frames or background. Generous transparent space between cells. Premium consistent hand-painted fantasy RPG style, sharp silhouette, cute heroic attitude without ferocity.

abilities:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent 3 by 3 atlas of NINE isolated magic ability rune icons for the exact orange/cyan rune fox game references. One unified premium hand-painted dimensional gold-and-gem style. Nine precisely equal square cells, generous transparent padding in each. No whole UI buttons or frames. No words, no labels, no numerals. Children do not rely on reading; each family has an unmistakable silhouette, not color alone.
ROW 1 — SHIELD: three ranks left to right. A large front-facing blue-cyan SHIELD silhouette. Rank 1: simple solid cyan shield with narrow gold rim. Rank 2: same core shield, brighter face with a clearly doubled rim and two compact outward wing-like facets. Rank 3: same core shield, bold polished gold outer guard, three broad cyan gem facets and stronger protective side arcs. Nothing sharp or aggressive.
ROW 2 — HEAL: three ranks left to right. A large warm pink glowing HEART held by fresh green leaves. Rank 1: one simple plump heart and two small leaves below. Rank 2: identical core heart, larger green leaf cradle, two tiny golden sparkles. Rank 3: identical core heart, broad emerald leaf wreath and warm gold edging, three restrained sparkles. Heart must remain a dominant clear shape at tiny size; do not use any cross symbol.
ROW 3 — RUNIC ATTACK: three ranks left to right. A single bold gold lightning BOLT with cyan magical core. Rank 1: one chunky bolt. Rank 2: same bolt with two short cyan flares to its sides. Rank 3: same bolt in a compact energetic sapphire/gold four-point starburst. Keep bolt instantly recognizable, no crossed swords.
The central icon shape and pose within each row remains identical; added border/large facets distinguish ranks. Do not use pips that look like multiple uses. No text, I/II/III, numbers, cell dividers, scenery, shadows on a backdrop, or decorative interface frames. Genuine alpha transparency. Every icon and all particles completely contained in its own cell with at least 15% empty margin. These are static concept icons; shared frame, hover, remaining-use status and runtime text will be composed in code.

rejectedEffects.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Three isolated shared MAGIC EFFECT LAYERS for the orange rune fox game, arranged in THREE equal square cells horizontally. Transparent background, generous 15% empty border inside EACH cell. Absolutely NO fox, creature, human, UI frame, text, numeral, ground, or scene. Effects only, to composite over an existing creature.
LEFT CELL: a single protective cyan SHIELD FIELD: translucent arched shield silhouette about 70% of cell height, thick luminous cyan double edge, very subtle transparent blue center, a few tiny gold sparks near the bottom corners. The middle is mostly clear so a character remains entirely visible through it. Ground attachment near bottom. No huge circles or opaque fill.
CENTER CELL: a HEALING BURST: a curved gentle swirl of fresh emerald and mint light rising from bottom to upper-right, three distinct warm pink HEART shapes ascending along the arc, a few small gold sparkles and two recognizable green leaf shapes. Most of cell empty; no opaque smoke/cloud. It must mean healing at small scale without any red cross.
RIGHT CELL: a single RUNIC ATTACK projectile moving RIGHT, horizontal: bold bright sapphire/cyan arrowlike comet with a short warm gold core shaped as a lightning bolt, two short cyan trails to the left, compact sharp gold-white hit sparkle at its right tip. About 65% of cell width, centered vertically. Do not put a shield outline around it.
Keep a cohesive polished hand-painted fantasy-game art style, strong clean shapes and very restrained particles. At least 15% fully empty margin beyond every glow, sparkle and trail in every equal square cell. No part cropped or touching a cell border. No lettering, labels, comparison signs or numbers. Small children cannot read: shield, heart and attacking bolt are self-explanatory visual actions. This is a static concept effect atlas, no fake creature animation. Genuine transparent alpha.
